comment: Budgets are gzip sizes in bytes. Initial JS and aggregate ceilings updated 2026-10-29 for the patched MapLibre 6.4.1 migration with approximately 10% measured headroom; see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-29-maplibre-budget.md. Other ceilings retain their prior measurements. Categories: main-js = the largest index-*.js plus separately emitted MapLibre worker JS (embedded in main before v6). lazy-js = OTHER dynamically-imported JS chunks (today: topojson-client). Under Vite 8/Rolldown this is emitted as src-*.js; under Rollup it was a second index-*.js. Both are lazy-loaded via dynamic import. css = sum of all index-*.css. async-countries = the countries-*.js chunk (lazy-loaded via dynamic import). initial-total = main-js + css (the first-paint blocker). total-with-async = initial + async-countries + lazy-js (full bandwidth a session may use). Updating a budget upward requires a separate PR with measurement evidence.
